privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must research Norway, United States, Brazil, India, and China. Required sources: rsf.org, freedomhouse.org, and cpj.org. Bookmark folder name: 'Press Freedom Research' (min 5 bookmarks). Output file: /home/ga/Documents/press_freedom_comparison.json. JSON fields per country: rsf_rank (int), freedom_house_score (0-100 int), freedom_house_status (Free/Partly Free/Not Free), cpj_journalists_imprisoned (int), and summary (string).
